item.title: Arkansas Symphony Orchestra announces 2026-2027 season
item.description: The Arkansas Symphony Orchestra announced its 2026-2027 season, featuring a major America 250 celebration honoring Florence Price, George Gershwin and Aaron Copland, and a landmark collaboration with Ballet Arkansas for Igor Stravinsky's "The Rite of Spring".

item.title: New commander for U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Little Rock District
item.description: Col. Eric R. Swenson has assumed command of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Little Rock District, which manages $30 billion in federal water resource infrastructure, including 12 multipurpose lakes, 13 locks and dams, 308 miles of navigation, 138 parks, and seven hydroelectric plants.

item.title: Arkansas State Red Wolves baseball beats #6 Arkansas Razorbacks 12-4
item.description: The Diamond Hogs struggled to catch up to the Red Wolves in Fayetteville on Tuesday.

item.title: Woodruff County residents frustrated as brown water persists
item.description: For hundreds of residents served by Cross County Rural Water, turning on the tap has become a daily source of frustration.

item.title: Lonoke County candidates concerned after county clerk resigns week before primary elections
item.description: LONOKE COUNTY, Ark. - On Sunday, Lonoke County Clerk Dawn Porterfield posted a resignation letter effective immediately. item.title: Small business owner from Hope gets opportunity to speak at White House event
item.description: Arnetta Bradford had owned a coffee shop called Hebrews 11:1 since 2019, but more recently, she was given the chance to speak at a Black History Month event at the White House.

item.title: Batesville School District appoints interim superintendent amid 'personnel matter'
item.description: Batesville School District officials announced a sudden change to district leadership on Tuesday night.

item.title: Little Rock native speaks on Puerto Vallarta cartel attacks after explosive hits her hotel
item.description: Puerto Vallarta has been Lacey Olson and her husband Sam's go-to vacation spot for several years. They arrived to their hotel on the beach on Saturday, a day before the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Reuben "El Mencho" Cervantes, was killed in a Mexican military operation.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.
